features: DREAM BIG & BUILD BIG: PicassoTiles magnet marble run tile construction playset themed Pete the Cat 4 piece marbles will be sure to be a hit with boys and girls ages 6 and up. Each ball has a printed Pete the Cat character. Kids will have fun navigating twists and turns as the balls race through structured maze racetracks. Perfect for pretend play, group activities, and classroom teamwork, this set is crafted to spark creativity, imagination, and foster learning in every building block session.

LEARNING IS FUN: Dive into the world of creativity and STEM education with our Pete the Cat-themed marbles, the ideal addition to any marble run maze building toy. This educational add on set promises endless enjoyment. Watch as the vibrant balls roll down magnetic marble run structured race track buildings, creating thrilling entertainment that never goes out of style. It's an enjoyable way to make learning a blast.

LEARNING BY PLAYING: It's never too early to start developing creativity and STEM skills, and this PicassoTiles Pete the Cat themed marble add-on toy can help nurture this. Children aged 6 years old and up will acquire visual learning, a strong sense of color, understanding of 3D forms, geometrical shapes, architectural design, magnetic polarities and structural engineering while incorporating this set into their marble run playset.

BONDING THROUGH PLAY: Whether enjoyed solo or with a group, gliding these mesmerizing Pete the Cat inspired marbles creates entertainment that transcends age barriers. This delightful playset offers an excellent way to spend quality time with family and friends. Whether it's a solo adventure or a shared experience, these marbles add a touch of enchantment to every marble run play session, nurturing bonds and creating cherished memories for all involved.

BPA-FREE & NON-TOXIC: We place safety above all else. Our PicassoTiles magnetic toy sets are BPA-free and non-toxic, creating a safe environment for your child's playtime. With us, you're not only guaranteeing enjoyable amusement but also embracing the peace of mind that comes from knowing your little one’s exploration is shielded from harmful elements.
